Couture Campaign

Silhouettes, Drape, and Architectural Heritage.

Mehr Couture crafts Indian occasion wear with an emphasis on tailored precision and refined jewel tones. Our campaign captured two contrasting atmospheres: moody studio portraiture exploring earthy olive and rust textures, and sweeping natural sunlight amidst the sandstone arches of Rajasthan.

By balancing structured architectural symmetry with effortless fabric movement, each image frames the garments as living works of wearable art.
